rules: One logical change per independently reviewable commit. No mixing pool/data-structure/lock/protocol changes.
Shared must compile/test independently without native consensus dependencies; native on exact shared tip.
Verified recovery bundle and dirty-source preservation before every history rewrite; retain refs and ownership ledger.
No weakened/deleted/bypassed assertions. Maintain strict clang thread-safety annotations.
Per commit: compile, zero new warnings against recorded baseline, immediate targeted unit/functional gates.
Performance claims require >=3 alternating before/after pairs, no overlapping build/indexer; keep profiled rates excluded.

items.scope: Node-owned bounded pool, one strand per peer, ordered ProcessMessages/SendMessages per peer; audit every old global-msgproc assumption; explicit shared-state locks and lifetime/drain before teardown.
